NOTES ON THE SATELLITE BOARD 12 e The satellite circuit board serves two important functions. First, it contains the program that the CPU requires in order to make the game run. Hecause the entire program is stored on this one small circuit board, it becomes very easy to convert yous game to another by simply changing satellite boards or by changing individual ROM memory chips on the board. The second major function of the satellite board is that it contains all of the bookkeeping information for that game. Through new RGM/RAM technology, this information can be held in a non-volatile memory without a battery backup. If you hold a satellite board with the chips facing you and the edge connector up, the two leftmost chips are RAM memory. The CPU not only stores the bookkeeping data here, but also uses 1t to keep track of the progression of the game. If there is a loss af power in the middie of a game, these chips remember where the game left off. When power is restored, the game can continue without any loss of continuity. The set. of large chips next to the RAM is the game program. Tf you have a JOKER POKER game, there wiil be three program chips and one empty cacket. If you have a 2-IN-1 game, there “will be four pragram chips. The program is stored in EFROM memory, therefore it is advised that the white labels on the chips not be remaved.
